info.name: Harbor Compliance Compliance Filings Jurisdictions API

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Filter jurisdictions by supported entity type.

items.docs: Returns a list of all supported jurisdictions with their compliance requirements, filing fees, and annual report due dates.

params.name: state
params.description: Two-letter state code (e.g., CA, NY, DE).

items.docs: Retrieves detailed compliance requirements for a specific state jurisdiction including annual report deadlines, filing fees, and registered agent requirements by entity type.
